sections.title: Scope And Discovery
sections.text: Requires an explicitly selected, already open document with a Design product; duplicate document names must be disambiguated by project ID in execution context. No activation or recompute. kind is optional; without it only direct bodies, sketches, features and construction planes/axes/points are listed. kind:point also includes sketch points; face/edge/vertex traverse direct bodies; profile traverses direct sketches. component, occurrence and parameter kinds ignore local enumeration scope and return all design definitions, root-context occurrences and design parameters respectively. component defaults to execution-context component (root initially); setting component clears inherited occurrence context; occurrence selects proxies and must agree with component. Discover instance paths with kind:occurrence, component definitions with kind:component, and topology with kind:face/edge/vertex.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: Handler returns {entities: Description[]} only, with no count. Each Description is itself a reusable reference, not an object with a ref key: root is {kind:'component',name:'root'}; other entities have token:string|null, kind:string, name:string|null, optional component:Ref, occurrence:Ref, occurrence path:string, profile sketch:Ref and an index only after explicit index selection. objectType:string is added. API-exposed fields are conditional: isValid/isVisible/isSolid/isSuppressed:boolean, errorOrWarningMessage:string, healthState:{value:integer,name:string}, boundingBox:{min:number[3],max:number[3],units:'cm'} (profile adds space:'sketch'), geometry:null or {type,lengthUnits:'cm',angleUnits:'rad',space:'assembly'|'component local', optional origin/center/normal/axis/direction/startPoint/endPoint/xyz:number[3], radius/majorRadius/minorRadius/halfAngle/startAngle/endAngle:number}. area/volume/length are {value:number,units:'cm^2'|'cm^3'|'cm'}. Profiles add area.accuracy:string, centroid:{xyz:number[3],units:'cm',space:'sketch'}, loops:integer,indexStability:string. Occurrences add transform:{type:'Matrix3D',matrix:number[16]}; translation entries use cm. Parameters add name/expression/unit/comment:string,value:number|string,valueType:'numeric'|'text',valueUnits:internal-unit label|null,metadata:object. Fields unavailable on an entity are omitted, not invented.

sections.title: Reference Wiring
sections.text: The executor wraps this as {success,operation,document,result,created}; result.entities is the list and created is empty. Choose by observed geometry/name, not blind list position. Pass the chosen description directly as entity.inspect.ref, or extract its token/kind/component/occurrence/path reference fields. In a batch, after deliberately identifying item 0 from a discovery step named bodies, use {"$ref":"bodies.result.entities.0"}. $ref is resolved by the batch runner only, not by the Python reference resolver. Tokens are opaque and may split or expire; re-discover after edits.

examples.label: Direct Root Bodies
examples.requires: An open Design document; no bodies is valid and returns an empty array.
examples.output: result.entities contains body descriptions, not result.bodies or entities[].ref.

examples.label: Discover Assembly Paths
examples.requires: An open Design document; instances need not exist.
examples.output: result.entities[].path is each full root-context occurrence path; preserve it with its token when reusing a nested occurrence.

verified: conditional description fields and reference paths

sections.title: GM03 Explicit Frames
sections.text: Supplying schemaVersion:1 or frame enables the extended snapshot descriptor with per-row frame, occurrencePath and body ref. frame accepts context/component/root, component or occurrence descriptor, sketch descriptor, or named datum descriptor; see docs/ENTITY_QUERIES.md. Native-to-root-to-output transforms are rigid and composed through every nested parent. Unqualified repeated definitions cannot be silently placed in root. Ref-only legacy calls preserve their original result shape and coordinate labels.

sections.title: Reference Input
sections.text: ref is an exact name/alias/origin string or object. Object keys used are token:string, kind:string, name:string, component:Ref, occurrence:Ref, path:string and, for profiles, sketch:Ref,index:integer or loopCount:positive integer. Allowed normal kinds: component,occurrence,body,sketch,feature,face,edge,vertex,profile,plane,axis,point,parameter. root/origin/XY/XZ/YZ/X/Y/Z are reserved references in the chosen context. Tokens are authoritative over display names, but not kind or explicit ownership. Occurrence path disambiguates token matches against root.allOccurrences; path alone is not a selector. Name lookup is exact and unique, not regex. Unqualified parameter names require kind:parameter; entity.list kind:parameter discovers them. Face/edge/vertex and sketch-curve tokens can be obtained by explicit UI selection or typed listing; unsupported sketch curves may be token-resolvable without being enumerable kinds. Do not invent tokens.

sections.title: Profiles And Context
sections.text: Use {kind:'profile',sketch:Ref} only when exactly one profile exists. index is explicit zero-based integer, never boolean, within current profile count; loopCount is a positive integer requiring exactly one matching profile and cannot coexist with index. A supplied token must resolve and agree with any explicit sketch/index or loopCount; it is not a fallback. Listing/inspection reports loops but does not invent indices. component clears inherited occurrence scope; occurrence must agree and produces proxies. Origin and name lookups default to execution context; token lookup is document-wide unless explicitly qualified. Stale/split tokens or ambiguous aliases raise; there is no first-match fallback. Read-only inspection does not activate or recompute.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result is the entity description itself. Reference keys: root has kind/name only; other entities token:string|null,kind:string,name:string|null, optional component:Ref,occurrence:Ref,path:string for occurrences,sketch:Ref and explicitly selected index:integer for profiles. Adds objectType:string and API-available isValid/isVisible/isSolid/isSuppressed:boolean,errorOrWarningMessage:string,healthState:{value:integer,name:string}. boundingBox is {min:number[3],max:number[3],units:'cm'}, with profile space:'sketch'. geometry is null or {type:string,lengthUnits:'cm',angleUnits:'rad',space:string,optional origin/center/normal/axis/direction/startPoint/endPoint/xyz:number[3],radius/majorRadius/minorRadius/halfAngle/startAngle/endAngle:number}; unsupported analytic types expose only available properties. area/volume/length are {value:number,units:string}. Profiles add area.accuracy,centroid:{xyz,units:'cm',space:'sketch'},loops:integer,indexStability:string. Occurrences add transform:{type:'Matrix3D',matrix:number[16]} with cm translations. Parameters add expression/unit/comment:string,value:number|string,valueType:'numeric'|'text',valueUnits:internal-unit label|null,metadata:object. Output is a snapshot, not a driving value. Executor output also has success,operation,document,created:[]; a later batch reference uses inspected.result, not inspected.result.ref.

examples.label: Origin Plane
examples.requires: Open Design document; XY uses the selected component/occurrence context.
examples.output: result.kind is plane; result.geometry is the available plane descriptor in cm/rad.

examples.label: Select Annular Profile By Loops
examples.requires: Discover Section with entity.list kind:sketch and inspect its profiles with kind:profile. Exactly one current profile must have two loops in the selected context.
examples.output: result.loops is 2; result.sketch identifies Section. No index is synthesized. Reuse the explicit sketch/loopCount selector if profile tokens are not resolvable.

examples.label: Explicit Profile Index
examples.requires: The user explicitly chose current zero-based profile 1 in Section; at least two profiles exist. Recheck after sketch edits.
examples.output: result.index is 1 and result.indexStability warns about topology changes.

verified: all reference and profile selection branches

sections.title: GM03 Extended Queries
sections.text: Use schemaVersion:1 for the full query result; new fields also opt into it. The legacy-only payload below retains its exact old result shape. Extended scope/instances/frame/expect/groupBy, length/radius intervals, bbox, level and adjacency all use the shared assets/cad/entity.py resolver. Full grammar and semantics: docs/ENTITY_QUERIES.md. Extended nonunique result includes refs/count/entities, expected-count success/status, rejected reasons, ambiguous candidates, unit-labelled statistics/groups, identity and snapshot provenance. unique:true still returns a single description or raises. Nothing stores an associative future-topology selection rule. Offline tests do not close native acceptance.

sections.title: Filters And Scope
sections.text: No required fields. kind defaults face and accepts component,occurrence,body,sketch,feature,face,edge,vertex,profile,plane,axis,point,parameter. component and occurrence are exact names or discovered reference objects; occurrence gives assembly-space proxies and must agree with component. filters defaults {}; only name (exact comparison), geometry (plane/cylinder/circle/line/point), radius,axis,position,tolerance,angleTolerance are allowed. radius/tolerance are nonnegative length expression strings; tolerance defaults '0.001 mm'. angleTolerance is an angle expression from 0 through 90 deg inclusive, default '0.01 deg'. axis is three finite numeric unitless components, nonzero and normalized; parallel and antiparallel match. position is three explicit length strings evaluated now in selected coordinates. Radius/position tolerance is absolute, not relative. Position tests infinite-plane distance, cylinder/infinite-line axis distance, or origin/center/point/start-point distance; finite Line3D tests its start point, not distance to its infinite extension. No face containment is tested. Missing requested analytic properties exclude candidates.

sections.title: Attribute Predicates
sections.text: filters.attributes is a nonempty AND-list of {group,name,value,owner} objects; every predicate must match in addition to the other filters. group and name are nonempty; value is an exact string comparison including the empty string. owner is required and selects the store with no fallback: native reads the nativeObject/native definition, proxy reads only the exact contextual proxy, occurrence reads the candidate occurrence or its exact assemblyContext. A missing store or a differing value is a nonmatch reported in rejected[].reasons (attribute missing / value mismatch); a structurally invalid predicate (empty/non-array list, missing or unknown field, blank group/name, non-string value, unknown owner) is a preflight error before any enumeration. Proxy/occurrence predicates are rejected on component candidates and otherwise require an occurrence scope, kind:occurrence, or instances:true. Hiding an entity does not exclude it: a hidden body whose attributes match is still returned. Attribute predicates use the extended result shape and never store a future-topology selection rule. See docs/ENTITY_QUERIES.md.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: unique omitted/false returns {entities:Description[],count:integer}; empty is valid. unique:true (strict boolean) instead returns one Description directly and errors for zero/multiple matches. Description keys are token:string|null,kind:string,name:string|null,objectType:string, optional component/occurrence:Ref,path:string,sketch:Ref,index:integer; root omits token. Conditional API fields: isValid/isVisible/isSolid/isSuppressed:boolean,errorOrWarningMessage:string,healthState:{value,name},boundingBox:{min,max:number[3],units:'cm',space?:'sketch'},geometry:null|{type,lengthUnits:'cm',angleUnits:'rad',space, optional origin/center/normal/axis/direction/startPoint/endPoint/xyz:number[3], radius/majorRadius/minorRadius/halfAngle/startAngle/endAngle:number},area/volume/length:{value,units}. Profiles add loops,centroid:{xyz,units,space},area.accuracy,indexStability; occurrences transform:{type,matrix:number[16]}; parameters expression,unit,value,valueType,valueUnits,comment,metadata. All are evaluated observations. Executor places this at result and has created:[]; unique search step bore wires to next input ref via {"$ref":"bore.result"}, nonunique via bore.result.entities.N only after deliberate selection.

sections.title: Safety And Limits
sections.text: Requires open Design document, no activation/recompute/mutation. Geometry feasibility and real tokens require live discovery, not offline validation. Candidates with absent or null geometry remain eligible for unfiltered and name-only searches and return their normal descriptions. Requested geometry, radius, axis or position filters exclude candidates whose geometry is unavailable; unique:true still refuses zero matches.

examples.label: List Planar Faces
examples.requires: Open Design document. No planar faces is a valid empty result.
examples.output: result.count matches result.entities.length.

examples.label: Unique Cylindrical Face
examples.requires: Exactly one current cylindrical face of radius 25 mm, with Z-parallel axis through the origin in selected context. Inspect all matches without unique first.
examples.output: result itself is the face description. Pass result as entity.alias.ref or measure.diameter.ref; no result.entities wrapper in unique mode.

examples.label: Bodies By Native Attribute
examples.requires: Open Design document; write the fmcad.metadata/role attribute on the body's native definition with entity.attribute.set first. Without it, zero matches is a valid result.
examples.output: result.refs/count/entities list only bodies whose native definition carries the exact attribute; nonmatches appear in result.rejected[].reasons.

examples.label: Instances By Occurrence Attribute
examples.requires: Open Design document with placed instances; occurrence owner requires instances:true (or an occurrence scope / kind:occurrence). Write the attribute on each owning occurrence with entity.attribute.set.
examples.output: result.count is the number of physical instances whose owning occurrence carries the attribute; each entity row retains its occurrencePath.

examples.label: Exact Proxy By Proxy Attribute
examples.requires: Open Design document with placed instances; proxy owner reads only the exact contextual proxy, so write the attribute to that proxy with entity.attribute.set, not the native definition.
examples.output: Returns only entities whose exact contextual proxy carries the attribute; native definitions with the same group/name/value do not match.

verified: every geometry filter and type mapping
namespaced attribute predicates across native/proxy/occurrence owners and occurrence-context requirements

sections.title: Input And Discovery
sections.text: Required ref resolves a token-bearing entity and alias is a nonempty string excluding root/origin/XY/XZ/YZ/X/Y/Z and re: prefix. Whitespace is not trimmed. ref may be exact unique name/alias, {token,kind?,component?,occurrence?,path?}, or profile {kind:'profile',sketch:Ref,index?:integer or loopCount?:positive integer}; index/loopCount are exclusive. Discover with entity.list/entity.find or selection.inspect, and use the returned description directly. root cannot be aliased because its reference deliberately omits its token. confirm is optional strict boolean, default absent: same resolved target is unchanged, different target needs true, stale old reference raises unless true bypasses resolution. Alias storage is document-wide root attributes, but unqualified alias lookup still obeys selected component ownership; qualify component/occurrence for child entities.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result is {alias:string,ref:Ref,changed:boolean}. Ref has token:string,kind:string,name:string|null, optional component:Ref,occurrence:Ref,path:string for occurrences,sketch:Ref,index:integer for explicitly selected profiles. These are references, not full descriptions. No created entities are appended: executor created is []. In a batch after alias step mount, pass {"$ref":"mount.result.ref"} as the next ref. After a unique entity.find step face, alias.ref may be {"$ref":"face.result"}. Do not use face.result.ref.

sections.title: Mutation Safety
sections.text: Stores metadata only; does not rename geometry or save. Executor may activate the target document for this mutation. Persistence requires a later user-requested save. Existing entity names can collide with the alias; creation does not precheck name collisions, so future resolution may be ambiguous. Topology edits may stale/split tokens; confirm does not make topology stable. Inspect after runtime failure before retrying.

examples.label: Alias A Discovered Body
examples.requires: entity.list kind:body established one BodyA in selected component and no conflicting mount_body name/alias. Use actual discovered ref when names are not unique.
examples.output: result.ref is reusable and result.changed is true, or false if already bound to this same entity.

examples.label: Explicit Replacement
examples.requires: User approved replacing mount_body, including stale bindings; BodyA was discovered in this document.
examples.output: result.changed is true because confirmation writes the binding even if unchanged.

sections.title: Prerequisites And Discovery
sections.text: Input is exactly {}. Target open Design document must already be active; no activation occurs. Select actual geometry in Fusion before calling to discover otherwise unnamed face/edge/sketch-curve tokens; empty UI selection is valid. UI selection is global and not saved with this command. No recompute or mutation. Unsupported serializable API types may raise instead of returning partial misleading text.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result is {selections:[{entity:Description,point:number[3],pointUnits:'cm'}]}. point is Fusion's selection point, not an inferred centroid. entity is a description/reference with token:string|null,kind:string,name:string|null,objectType:string and optional component/occurrence:Ref,path,sketch,index. Root omits token. Conditional API fields include boolean validity/visibility/solid/suppressed state, errorOrWarningMessage,healthState:{value,name},boundingBox:{min,max,units:'cm',space?},geometry:null|{type,lengthUnits:'cm',angleUnits:'rad',space, available vectors:number[3] and analytic radii/angles:number},area/volume/length:{value,units}. Profiles include loops,centroid:{xyz,units,space},area.accuracy,indexStability; occurrences transform:{type,matrix}; parameters expression/unit/value/valueType/valueUnits/comment/metadata. The selection inspection itself does not assign a profile index. Executor created is []. Pass result.selections[0].entity directly as a ref only after identifying that selected item. In a batch named selected the path is selected.result.selections.0.entity, not selected.result.selections.0.ref.

examples.label: Inspect Current Selection
examples.requires: Target Design document already active; user-selected entities if references are desired.
examples.output: result.selections is an array; each entity contains its reusable reference and each point uses cm.

verified: selection point and nested entity output

sections.title: Input And Safety
sections.text: refs must be an array, including empty; each item is a name/alias/origin or discovered {token,kind?,component?,occurrence?,path?} reference, or explicit profile sketch/index or loopCount selector. replace is optional strict boolean default true. Target Design document must already be active even though this command is a mutation. Resolve every reference before changing selection. replace:true clears first; false appends. Empty refs clears only with replace:true. A later API clear/add failure may leave the selection partially changed; inspect selection rather than assuming rollback. No model geometry, camera or save changes.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result is {highlighted:Ref[],selectionCount:integer}. highlighted contains only requested references, not all preexisting selections; selectionCount is the actual total afterward. Ref fields: token:string|null,kind:string,name:string|null, optional component/occurrence:Ref,path:string for occurrences,sketch:Ref,index:integer for explicitly selected profiles; root has kind/name only. Executor created is []. A later inspection can use result.highlighted[0]; batch path highlight.result.highlighted.0. To highlight a previously chosen listing item use refs:[{"$ref":"bodies.result.entities.0"}] in a batch, or insert that description directly for a standalone call.

examples.label: Clear Selection
examples.requires: Target Design document already active; user intends to clear UI selection.
examples.output: result.highlighted is []; result.selectionCount is 0.

examples.label: Append Origin Plane
examples.requires: Target Design document already active and XY selectable in current Fusion state.
examples.output: result.highlighted contains XY reference; selectionCount includes any preexisting selections.

sections.title: Nested Batch Schema
sections.text: parameters is a nonempty array; each object accepts only name,expression,unit,comment,metadata. name matches [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z_0-9]* and is unique in batch. expression required: nonempty string; finite numbers only when unit:'' (never boolean). New parameter requires unit:string; existing uses old unit if omitted and cannot change it. Text/model-parameter writes unsupported. comment:string defaults '' on creation and existing comment on update. metadata defaults {} merged into old metadata; only protected:boolean,source:string,tolerance:nonnegative compatible expression string or null. Null disables tolerance validation and remains stored; empty object does not clear old metadata. Ordinary expressions support forward dependencies, topological ordering and cycle rejection. Tolerance is validated against current design, not expanded pending parameters, so use literal units or existing parameters for metadata.tolerance. Numeric unitless values become expression strings; dimensional input requires explicit units or a dimensional parameter reference.

sections.title: Overwrite And Safety
sections.text: overwrite and confirm are optional strict booleans. Any changed existing expression/comment/metadata needs overwrite:true; if previously protected, confirm:true is also required even to remove protection. Equality strips whitespace only from expressions: '10 mm' versus '1 cm' is a change despite equal numeric value. Prevalidation checks all entries before writes, but setters/add/attributes can fail midway with no rollback. Runtime failures may leave new parameters or changed expressions; inspect before retry. Executor may activate target document. Values returned are evaluated internal-unit snapshots, while stored expression strings remain driving relationships. Descriptive source/tolerance metadata enforces no modeling bounds. No automatic save or design-type change.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result is {parameters:ParameterInfoWithChanged[],prevalidated:true,atomic:false}; rows are dependency order, not necessarily request order. Each row has name:string,expression:string,unit:string,value:number,valueType:'numeric',valueUnits:'Fusion internal units (cm, rad, kg, s)',comment:string,metadata:object,changed:boolean. metadata has only supplied/preserved protected/source/tolerance keys, possibly tolerance:null. No per-row ref/token is returned. Executor created contains references for newly added parameters only, {token,kind:'parameter',name}, not updated/no-op parameters. To refer later use {kind:'parameter',name:row.name}, or deliberately selected created entry. For driving dimensions use the parameter name string, not result.parameters.N.value (a snapshot in internal units).

examples.label: Forward Dependency And Unitless Count
examples.requires: Open Design document, names absent or exactly matching existing values; drawing metadata is user-provided evidence, not verified by command.
examples.output: result.parameters names are wall,outside,count; values use internal units. New parameters also appear in executor created.

examples.label: Approved Protected Update
examples.requires: Existing numeric user parameter wall in mm, discovered with param.inspect, and explicit approval to update/unprotect it.
examples.output: result.parameters[0].changed is true when data differs; metadata.tolerance remains null and comment/source are preserved.

verified: every nested key and conditional requirement
forward dependency order and expression preservation
actual parameter result versus created refs

sections.title: Input And Discovery
sections.text: No required fields. names omitted or null selects all in chosen collection; otherwise an array of exact name strings (empty returns []; repeated names produce repeated rows); unknown/ambiguous names raise. includeModel strict boolean defaults false, true uses design.allParameters. Parameters are design-wide, not selected-component scoped; external referenced-design parameters are outside that API collection. Use this command to discover parameter names before param.apply or parameter.test; for entity-style refs use {kind:'parameter',name:discoveredName}. No activation, recompute or writes.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result is {parameters:[{name:string,expression:string,unit:string,value:number|string,valueType:'numeric'|'text',valueUnits:string|null,comment:string,metadata:object}]}. Numeric values use Fusion internal units (cm,rad,kg,s), not the displayed unit. Text unit (case-insensitive) returns textValue and valueUnits:null. metadata defaults {} and can contain protected:boolean,source:string,tolerance:string|null from parameter-attached attributes. No token/ref/changed field is returned. Executor created is []. Stored expressions are driving relationships; values are observations. For the inspected step, result.parameters.N.name is a name string and cannot serve as a dimensioned numeric value without the parameter relationship.

examples.label: Discover All Design Parameters
examples.requires: Open Design document; no parameter names need be known.
examples.output: result.parameters includes user and model parameters, with expression and evaluated value distinguished.

examples.label: Inspect Named User Parameters
examples.requires: Discover wall and outside with param.inspect or create the forward-dependency param.apply example first.
examples.output: result.parameters follows requested name order; metadata and internal-unit values are available per row.

sections.title: Discovery And Limits
sections.text: Optional name is an exact user/model parameter name discovered by param.inspect includeModel:true; omitted means all design.allParameters in API order. No component/occurrence filter, mutation, activation or recompute. This is only the API-exposed parameter equation graph, never complete downstream feature/geometry/external-design impact. A null list means the installed API lacks that direction, while [] means exposed but empty. Do not treat either as permission to modify a protected or safety-critical parameter.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result is {parameters:[{name:string,expression:string,dependsOn:string[]|null,usedByParameters:string[]|null}],coverage:'partial',limitations:string[]}. Rows omit values, units, tokens and refs. Executor created is []. Use a returned dependency name as param.inspect.names item, or {kind:'parameter',name:thatName} for entity.inspect/parameter.test. In a batch, names:[{"$ref":"graph.result.parameters.0.name"}] is valid only after selecting that row; graph.result.parameters.0 is not itself an entity ref.

examples.label: Discover Dependency Coverage
examples.requires: Open Design document; API dependency properties may be unavailable.
examples.output: result.coverage is always partial; each direction is a name array or null.

examples.label: One Parameter Graph
examples.requires: wall exists as an exact design parameter name discovered through param.inspect.
examples.output: result.parameters has one row, not a singular result.parameter.

verified: direction names and partial graph semantics

sections.title: Exclusive Modes
sections.text: name is a nonblank string unique among selected component construction planes. offset mode (default) requires offset:length expression and allows plane:Ref default XY; only name,mode,offset,plane are accepted. mid requires plane1,plane2 planar refs and only name,mode,plane1,plane2; nonparallel gives Fusion's bisector, coplanar fails in Fusion. angle requires axis:linear reference,plane:baseline planar reference,angle:angle expression and only name,mode,axis,plane,angle. There are no coordinates, normal-vector, overwrite or confirm modes. Signed dimensional strings require units or existing parameters, even for zero. setByOffset/setByAngle use ValueInput expression strings so relationships remain driving, not numeric snapshots.

sections.title: Scope And Safety
sections.text: Requires open Design document, existing valid referenced geometry and unused name. Origin XY/XZ/YZ and X/Y/Z refer to selected component/occurrence. Other refs are exact unique names/aliases or discovered {token,kind?,component?,occurrence?,path?}; discover with entity.list/find/selection.inspect. Creation uses ctx.component and supplies creationOccurrence when selected, with output proxy. No modeling-mode switch, automatic overwrite or save. Executor may activate target document. API failure after add/name/proxy/serialization may leave geometry despite failure; inspect before retry.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result is the new plane Description, not {plane:...} or {ref:...}: token:string|null,kind:'plane',name:string,objectType:string,component:Ref,optional occurrence:Ref and available isValid/isVisible:boolean,healthState:{value:integer,name:string},errorOrWarningMessage:string,boundingBox:{min:number[3],max:number[3],units:'cm'},geometry:{type:'Plane',origin:number[3],normal:number[3],lengthUnits:'cm',angleUnits:'rad',space:'assembly'|'component local'} (API-dependent fields may be omitted or geometry null). Executor created includes the new plane Ref, without its description fields. After step offset, next datum.plane.plane can be {"$ref":"offset.result"}; returned geometric numbers are evaluated cm/rad, not driving expressions.

examples.label: Signed Offset
examples.requires: Open Design document; mount_plane absent in selected component. XY origin is the default base.
examples.output: result.kind is plane; created[0] identifies mount_plane.

examples.label: Bisect Origin Planes
examples.requires: bisector unused; current Fusion modeling mode supports two-plane construction. Nonparallel input intentionally requests a bisector.
examples.output: result is the new bisecting plane description.

examples.label: Angle From Baseline
examples.requires: tilted_plane unused; X lies in XY in the selected context.
examples.output: result geometry is an evaluated snapshot; feature angle remains driven by the supplied expression where modeling mode supports it.

sections.title: Exclusive Modes
sections.text: name:nonblank string and mode required. circularFace accepts only name,mode,face:Ref resolving kind face with cylindrical/conical/toroidal geometry supported by Fusion. twoPlanes accepts only name,mode,plane1,plane2 and requires nonparallel planar entities. twoPoints accepts only name,mode,point1,point2 with distinct construction/sketch points or vertices supported by setByTwoPoints. edge accepts only name,mode,edge with linear/circular edge or compatible sketch curve. Ref inputs are names/aliases/origins or {token,kind?,component?,occurrence?,path?} from entity.list/find/selection.inspect. Sketch curves not covered by named enumeration should use selected tokens. No arbitrary vector/transient line fallback; no dimension fields or overwrite.

sections.title: Prerequisites And Safety
sections.text: Create in execution-context component with optional occurrence creation context; name must not already exist in that constructionAxes collection. Origin refs X/Y/Z/XY/XZ/YZ/origin are component/context-relative. Source geometry must be valid for the actual Fusion mode; parallel planes/coincident points/incompatible edges fail through API. Executor may activate target document, never switches designType or saves. Partial creation/name/proxy failures are not rolled back; inspect before retry.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result is axis Description: token:string|null,kind:'axis',name:string,objectType:string,component:Ref,optional occurrence:Ref, API-available isValid/isVisible:boolean,errorOrWarningMessage:string,healthState:{value,name},boundingBox:{min,max:number[3],units:'cm'},geometry:null|{type:string,lengthUnits:'cm',angleUnits:'rad',space:'assembly'|'component local',optional origin/direction/startPoint/endPoint:number[3]}. No axis/ref wrapper. Executor created includes this axis Ref. Feed axisStep.result directly to a later datum.plane.axis or entity.inspect.ref; values in geometry are evaluated snapshots, not independent driving parameters.

examples.label: Intersect Two Origin Planes
examples.requires: Open Design document, shaft_axis unused.
examples.output: result.kind is axis and created[0] is its reference.

examples.label: Circular Face Axis
examples.requires: Discover a cylindrical face with entity.find then bind alias cylinder_face with entity.alias. bore_axis must be unused.
examples.output: result is the associative construction-axis description, subject to current modeling mode.

examples.label: Axis Through Points
examples.requires: Create/discover mount_center as a distinct construction point; point_axis unused.
examples.output: result describes the axis; no input points are returned.

examples.label: Axis From Selected Edge
examples.requires: Discover a valid linear edge via selection.inspect/entity.list and alias it straight_edge; edge_axis unused.
examples.output: result is the new axis description, reusable directly as a ref.

sections.title: Exclusive Modes
sections.text: name:nonblank unique construction-point name. coordinates (default) accepts only name,mode,point:string[3] of signed length expressions with units or parameter references. It also reserves construction-plane names name__x/name__y/name__z before writing. Three hidden offset planes from native YZ/XZ/XY, corrected for origin-plane normal sign, preserve signed coordinate expressions through zero. threePlanes accepts only name,mode,plane1,plane2,plane3:Ref giving a unique intersection. reference accepts only name,mode,ref resolving SketchPoint or BRepVertex; ConstructionPoint/origin is explicitly unsupported in reference mode. No direct Point3D fallback, vector frame or overwrite mode.

sections.title: Scope And Discovery
sections.text: coordinates always use component-local coordinates even in an occurrence execution context; helper planes and intersection are native and the final output is proxied if selected via occurrence. threePlanes/reference explicitly reject any proxy or geometry owned by another component. In an occurrence context qualify each native input with component (and omit occurrence) to clear inherited proxy context. Discover refs by entity.list kind:plane/point/vertex or selection.inspect, then use token/kind/component fields, or a unique exact name/alias. Output proxies do not make coordinate strings assembly-space. All geometry feasibility is live API dependent.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result is point Description: token:string|null,kind:'point',name:string,objectType:string,component:Ref,optional occurrence:Ref, and available isValid/isVisible:boolean,healthState:{value,name},errorOrWarningMessage:string,boundingBox:{min,max:number[3],units:'cm'},geometry:null|{type:'Point3D',xyz:number[3],lengthUnits:'cm',angleUnits:'rad',space:string}. coordinates additionally returns representation:'intersection of three expression-driven offset planes' and helpers:Ref[3] in x,y,z order. Other modes omit representation/helpers. Executor created contains only final point Ref, not helpers. Next step ref may use pointStep.result; helper plane can use pointStep.result.helpers.0. Geometry coordinates are evaluated cm snapshots; helper offsets retain expressions.

sections.title: Mutation Safety
sections.text: Executor may activate target document. No design-type switch or save. All coordinate expressions and helper-name collisions are checked before helpers are added, but API failures during construction can leave some or all hidden helper planes without a point; helpers are not in created on failure. Inspect construction planes and point names before retry. Associativity follows current component/design modeling mode.

examples.label: Signed Local Coordinates
examples.requires: Open Design document; mount_center and all three helper-plane names unused in selected component.
examples.output: result.helpers has x/y/z plane refs; created includes only mount_center.

sections.title: Input And Representation
sections.text: Required name:nonblank component-scoped string, origin:three length expression strings, xAxis/yAxis:three finite numeric unitless components each (no booleans). Both vectors must be nonzero; normalized dot-product magnitude must be <=1e-9. Z is normalized X cross normalized Y; vectors are not automatically orthogonalized. mode accepts only metadata (default). Origin is evaluated in component-local coordinates, even in an occurrence context. This stores component attributes, not a native coordinate system or resolvable CAD entity. Origin expressions are retained as evidence but do not regenerate the transform on parameter edits.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result has name:string,kind:'frame',representation:'named transform metadata',component:Ref,matrix:number[16] from Matrix3D.asArray (row-major affine transform, translations at indices 3,7,11 in cm),lengthUnits:'cm',originExpressions:string[3],xAxis:number[3],yAxis:number[3],parametric:false,space:'component local',limitations:string[],changed:boolean. There is no token,ref,occurrence or zAxis output. New creation appends executor created entry {token:null,kind:'frame',name,component,representation}; replacement/no-op does not append. The matrix can be consumed as numeric data but neither result nor created[0] is accepted by ctx.resolve as a modeling frame.

sections.title: Persistence And Safety
sections.text: Requires open Design document; executor may activate it. Identical stored metadata returns changed:false; different metadata requires confirm:true, a strict boolean. Equality includes original expression strings, not just evaluated position. No dedicated frame listing/read operation exists; reapplying identical data reports it. No geometry or automatic save; metadata persists on next explicit save. Inspect after attribute-write failures. This is not a manufacturing datum acceptance check.

examples.label: Store Local Frame Snapshot
examples.requires: Open Design document; mount_frame absent or identical in selected component.
examples.output: result.xAxis/yAxis are normalized; result.matrix[11] is 2.5 cm and parametric is false.

examples.label: Approved Snapshot Replacement
examples.requires: Explicit approval to replace existing mount_frame metadata in selected component.
examples.output: result.changed is true if metadata differs; result.matrix[11] is 3 cm. No native frame is created.
